scope: All 13 Todd SE videos; frozen reviewed metric trajectories, source video hashes verified; no new detector training
windows: Disjoint chunks within each supported ego segment; retain final chunks with at least 5 samples. 21 samples span 2.0 s; minimum 5 spans 0.4 s. No time stretching or long-gap completion.
leader_input: Observed paired speed and net gap interpolated only inside same-pair segments with gaps <=0.2 s. Missing values become zero after normalization and have per-feature masks. Reviewed absent, not-visible, present states are separate channels.
features_policy: Window-local source-compatible Savitzky-Golay smoothing, up to 7 samples; derivatives do not cross missing-leader boundaries. No GPS, filenames, absolute times, absolute positions, or direction metadata in neural inputs.
quality: Recompute fixed-delay GPS errors on the prior temporal holdout; report all 13, including missing GPS and insufficient support. Flag speed MAE >1 m/s descriptively, not as a classifier inclusion gate.
transfer: Reuse original 11-feature Transformer; attention padding mask and missing-feature/state projection added. Encoder, positional and CLS embeddings frozen; input projection, missing projection and classifier fine-tuned. Train-fold normalization is analytically mapped to source input projection at initialization.
split: Leave one entire video out: 13 outer folds. From remaining videos select one AV and one HV for validation deterministically by outer index; train on remaining 10. All windows of a video stay together.
objective: BCE equally weighted by class, then video, then window; validation BCE equally weighted by video; include epoch 0 as a checkpoint candidate
normalization: Fit per-feature mean/std using training videos only and valid values only; video-balanced moments, std floor 0.1; no source speed clipping or high-speed threshold
aggregation: Average disjoint-window probabilities per video, then average the 3 prespecified seed probabilities. Count 13 videos, not windows or seed replicates, as evaluation units.
simple_baselines: Fixed L2 logistic C=1, class-balanced, train-fold standardized inputs. Mean-speed only and availability/duration-only controls; no test-guided tuning.
legacy_comparison: Preserve existing source-frozen Transformer/CNN predictions on 2 eligible paired videos as a different-coverage baseline; also report neural results on those same 2 videos separately.
limitations: Exploratory within-camera, repeated-vehicle development evaluation. Video holdout prevents window leakage but is not independent camera/vehicle/session generalization. Some detector adaptation used Todd videos. Padding support expands coverage, not observation duration or motion validity.
post_evaluation: Do not retune against outer predictions or promote a deployment model from these results; retain fold checkpoints, logs, predictions and limitations.
